text:
jade_marketing: Heads-up — finalizing a compact price page experiment for next week. Primary goal: reduce hesitation on committing to dedicated tiers and drive webinar signups.

sanjay_growth: Do we want to surface the calculator more aggressively or focus on tightening the FAQ first?

jade_marketing: Both — two-variant roll: Variant A bumps a calculator to the top with a compact summary and CTA; Variant B keeps calc lower but rewrites FAQ microcopy to answer the top 3 objections. We also want a small benchmark snippet on both.

tom_engineering: We can return a pricing-preview endpoint to power the calc: /pricing-preview?batch=... will include a classification. Example payload we plan to return: ```{"monthly_est":1234, "est_class":"smb"}```

elaine_ops: Sales asked for routing: any visitor whose calc returns est_class=enterprise should be tagged and routed to the enterprise SDR queue. Is that doable via GTM?

max_sales: Yes please. Route trials/requests with estimated >50k tokens/month or est_class=enterprise to the enterprise queue. Also want a CSV export hook so SDRs can quickly ingest leads.

jade_marketing: Plan for tagging: calc writes a hidden GTM field `pricing_segment`. @tom_engineering can you return `pricing_segment` values like dev/smb/enterprise? We'll use that to trigger routing.

tom_engineering: Yep — will add `pricing_segment` (dev|smb|enterprise) and a region param. We'll also add a `save` action that emits a UUID so marketing can link to webinar registrations.

sanjay_growth: Webinar tie-in: working title is "Serving Economics: picking model + config for predictable costs". Include a short callout on the pricing page with a single-line CTA and preset utm for tracking. Use the same workload we show in the benchmark snippet to avoid confusion.

max_sales: Webinar ought to include a 1-pager sales cheat sheet (3 talking points + ROI exemplar). If someone clicks to save calc results and provides email, prefill registration and include that lead on a priority follow-up list.

jade_marketing: Action items:
1) FAQ microcopy (3 bullets per tier) — @elaine_ops, EOD Wed.
2) Calc UX + GTM tagging + /pricing-preview — @tom_engineering, Fri.
3) Webinar CTA creative + benchmark narrative — @sanjay_growth, Mon.
4) CSV export + save-to-email hook — @tom_engineering + @max_sales, Fri.

elaine_ops: I'll draft FAQ blurbs. Quick question: can we add a one-liner for Private (VPC/on-prem) customers explaining contact flow? They want explicit mention of SLAs.

jade_marketing: Yes — include a short sentence linking to Private contact form and a note that Dedicated has SLA options. Keep it microcopy, one line.

sanjay_growth: For the benchmark narrative, pick two knobs to highlight: batch size and quantization. Language should avoid absolutes: use "typical savings observed" and provide a range (e.g., "~20–40% lower cost/token in high-throughput configs").

tom_engineering: Infra will surface two precomputed benchmark profiles: "low-latency" and "high-throughput" with median cost/token and median p95 latency. I'll add those as static values the calc can show.

max_sales: Also request: make sure the calc can export a one-line summary for SDRs and a downloadable CSV of the detailed estimate. That reduces friction in handoffs.

jade_marketing: Good. Also let's include a subtle microconversion: "Email me this estimate" that creates a lead and prepopulates the webinar reg form if they click register.

tom_engineering: We'll implement save -> UUID -> redirect to /webinar-registration?lead_id=UUID if email provided.

mkt-bot: Reminder: design review today 3pm PST — calendar link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/3pm-design-review

sanjay_growth: A/B test hypothesis to track: Variant A (calc prominence + benchmark) increases webinar signups from pricing page by 25% vs control. Metrics to watch: calc engagement rate, email-capture rate, webinar CTR, demo booking conversion, and lead quality.

max_sales: Lead quality metrics: demo-to-deal ratio, average ARR expectation from leads routed, and time-to-first-contact.

jade_marketing: I'll set dashboards for those. One more ask: localization for EU — show VAT-inclusive numbers and mention Dedicated SLA. @elaine_ops can you own copy variants?

elaine_ops: Yep — will prepare EN/EU variants and note VAT.

tom_engineering: Noted — I'll add `region` param to /pricing-preview and return VAT-adjusted estimates when region=EU.

jade_marketing: Excellent. Thanks team :rocket:
